title: soehrensia shaferi
intro: Soehrensia shaferi, commonly known as the "Rock Rose", is a plant species native to the Americas, belonging to the family Cactaceae. The health benefits of Soehrensia shaferi include its potential to aid in wound healing and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Soehrensia shaferi include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
